text:
maria: hey team, quick Q — I have a failing model inference and the trace link in the console is missing. I do have a request_id: 7f3a2b1c. What’s the fastest way to find the raw logs (console or CLI)?

sam: try the Console Request Explorer first — paste the request_id into the search bar, set timeframe +-5m. If no hit, it usually means the request never reached the runtime that emits the req logs.

alex: if Console fails, use the CLI to hunt: `redwoodctl logs --request-id 7f3a2b1c --since 10m` — that'll search centralized logs. Example: ```
$ redwoodctl logs --request-id 7f3a2b1c --since 10m 
2024-02-07T15:12:34Z [router] incoming x-request-id=7f3a2b1c
2024-02-07T15:12:34Z [inference-worker] span=abc123 error=timeout
```

maria: thanks. I don’t have redwoodctl installed on my laptop. Any short workaround from Console?

devon: you can go to Observability -> Logs -> query: `json.request_id: "7f3a2b1c" OR attributes.request_id: "7f3a2b1c"` then set `@timestamp >= "2024-02-07T15:10:00Z"`. Console saves a permalink you can paste in PRs.

alex: also check the trace index: in Traces view search for span tags `request_id=7f3a2b1c`. Sometimes the request_id is `x-request-id` vs `request_id` — try both.

maria: ran the logs query, found router logs but no worker logs. Any suggestions on what to check next?

sam: ping the runtime team — could be that the worker crashed before it flushed logs. @devon can you look at the worker pod for that timeframe?

devon: on it. Quick note: if you want CLI but don’t want to install, use the Cloud Shell in Console (bottom-right) — `redwoodctl` is preinstalled there. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot noticed a restart of `inference-worker-3` at 2024-02-07T15:11:58Z (reason: OOMKilled).

maria: ahh that would explain it. So worker OOM killed and didn't produce full logs. How do we surface that in the postmortem?

sam: capture the router logs + pod restart event + the partial worker logs. Include the binpack/instance id from router log line. Recommend adding an alert for worker OOM rate > 0 in 5m.

maria: noted. I’ll file a quick incident note and include the Console permalink for the router logs. Thanks all. :pray:
